using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

// Generated by the Warboard v35 structural refactor.
// Method bodies were moved verbatim from GameController.cs.
public partial class GameController : MonoBehaviour
{
    private List<SquadController>
        UndeployedUnitsForFaction(
            string faction)
    {
        return squads
            .Where(
                squad =>
                    squad.FactionId ==
                        faction &&
                    squad.BattlefieldState ==
                        SquadBattlefieldState.Undeployed &&
                    !squad.IsAttachedLeader
            )
            .ToList();
    }

    private SquadController FindNextUndeployedForFaction(
        string faction)
    {
        return squads.FirstOrDefault(
            squad =>
                squad.FactionId == faction &&
                squad.BattlefieldState ==
                    SquadBattlefieldState.Undeployed
        );
    }

    private void StartFactionBattleRoundRules()
    {
        if (factionRules != null)
        {
            factionRules.StartBattleRound(
                round,
                squads
            );
        }

        if (aeldariRules != null)
        {
            foreach (string faction
                in factions)
            {
                aeldariRules.StartBattleRound(
                    faction,
                    squads
                );
            }
        }
    }

    public int GetCommandPoints(
        string faction)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
            faction))
        {
            return 0;
        }

        int value;

        return commandPoints.TryGetValue(
            faction,
            out value)
            ? value
            : 0;
    }

    public void GainCommandPoints(
        string faction,
        int amount)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
            faction) ||
            amount <= 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (!commandPoints.ContainsKey(
            faction))
        {
            commandPoints[faction] = 0;
        }

        commandPoints[faction] +=
            amount;
    }

    public bool TrySpendCommandPoints(
        string faction,
        int amount)
    {
        if (amount <= 0)
            return true;

        int current =
            GetCommandPoints(
                faction
            );

        if (current < amount)
            return false;

        commandPoints[faction] =
            current -
            amount;

        return true;
    }

    public bool ArmCommandReroll(
        CommandRerollStage stage)
    {
        if (stage ==
            CommandRerollStage.None)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (phase != Phase.Shoot &&
            phase != Phase.Fight)
        {
            status =
                "Hit/Wound Command Re-roll can only be armed during Shoot or Fight.";
            return false;
        }

        if (GetCommandPoints(
            activeFaction) < 1)
        {
            status =
                ActiveFactionDisplayName() +
                " has no CP available.";
            return false;
        }

        if (!IsXcomMode)
        {
            if (!TrySpendCommandPoints(
                    activeFaction,
                    1))
            {
                return false;
            }

            showStratagemMenu = false;
            ClearArmedCommandReroll();

            OpenTraditionalDicePrompt(
                1
            );

            AppendBattleLog(
                "STRATAGEM",
                "Command Re-roll",
                ActiveFactionDisplayName() +
                " spent 1 CP for Command Re-roll (" +
                stage.ToString() +
                "). Player performs the reroll manually."
            );

            status =
                "COMMAND RE-ROLL: 1 CP spent. Reroll the appropriate physical die yourself; Warboard will not generate or judge the result.";

            return true;
        }

        armedCommandRerollStage =
            stage;

        armedCommandRerollFaction =
            activeFaction;

        showStratagemMenu = false;

        status =
            "Command Re-roll armed for the next failed " +
            stage.ToString().ToUpper() +
            " roll made by " +
            ActiveFactionDisplayName() +
            ". 1 CP is spent only if the reroll is actually triggered.";

        return true;
    }

    public bool TryConsumeArmedCommandReroll(
        string faction,
        CommandRerollStage stage,
        int originalRoll,
        int requiredRoll,
        SquadController source,
        SquadController target,
        out int rerolledValue)
    {
        rerolledValue =
            originalRoll;

        if (!IsXcomMode)
        {
            if (armedCommandRerollStage ==
                    stage &&
                string.Equals(
                    armedCommandRerollFaction,
                    faction,
                    System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                status =
                    "TRADITIONAL COMMAND RE-ROLL: reroll the physical die yourself. Warboard will not generate or validate the replacement result.";

                ClearArmedCommandReroll();
            }

            return false;
        }

        if (stage ==
            CommandRerollStage.None ||
            armedCommandRerollStage !=
                stage ||
            !string.Equals(
                armedCommandRerollFaction,
                faction,
                System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (source != null &&
            source
                .JoinedActionController()
                .IsBattleShocked)
        {
            ClearArmedCommandReroll();

            status =
                source.DisplayName +
                " is Battle-shocked and cannot be targeted by Command Re-roll.";

            return false;
        }

        // Only trigger the armed reroll when the roll actually failed.
        if (originalRoll >=
            requiredRoll)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (source == null ||
            !SpendStratagemCPForUnit(
                source,
                1,
                "Command Re-roll"))
        {
            ClearArmedCommandReroll();

            return false;
        }

        rerolledValue =
            DiceRoller.RollD6(
                "Command Re-roll: " +
                stage.ToString()
            );

        GameEventBus.Raise(
            new GameEventContext
            {
                Type =
                    stage ==
                    CommandRerollStage.Hit
                    ? GameEventType.HitRolled
                    : GameEventType.WoundRolled,
                Game = this,
                ActingFaction =
                    faction,
                Phase = phase,
                Source = source,
                Target = target,
                RollTotal =
                    rerolledValue,
                PreviousRollTotal =
                    originalRoll,
                IsReroll = true,
                Note =
                    "Command Re-roll"
            }
        );

        status =
            "Command Re-roll: " +
            originalRoll +
            " → " +
            rerolledValue +
            " on a " +
            stage.ToString().ToLowerInvariant() +
            " roll. " +
            GetCommandPoints(
                faction
            ) +
            " CP remaining.";

        ClearArmedCommandReroll();

        return true;
    }

    private void ClearArmedCommandReroll()
    {
        armedCommandRerollStage =
            CommandRerollStage.None;

        armedCommandRerollFaction =
            "";
    }

    private string ArmedCommandRerollText()
    {
        if (armedCommandRerollStage ==
            CommandRerollStage.None)
        {
            return "None";
        }

        return
            "Command Re-roll: next failed " +
            armedCommandRerollStage.ToString();
    }

    private int TotalBattleFocusTokens(
        string faction)
    {
        int baseTokens =
            factionRules != null
            ? factionRules
                .GetBattleFocusTokens(
                    faction
                )
            : 0;

        int bonusTokens =
            aeldariRules != null
            ? aeldariRules
                .BonusBattleFocus(
                    faction
                )
            : 0;

        return
            Mathf.Max(
                0,
                baseTokens +
                bonusTokens
            );
    }

    private bool UnitHasBattleFocusRules(
        SquadController unit)
    {
        if (unit == null)
            return false;

        bool native =
            factionRules != null &&
            factionRules.UnitHasBattleFocus(
                unit,
                squads
            );

        bool spiritGuides =
            aeldariRules != null &&
            aeldariRules
                .GrantsBattleFocusFromSpiritGuides(
                    unit,
                    squads
                );

        return native || spiritGuides;
    }

    private bool CanUseBattleFocusManoeuvre(
        SquadController unit)
    {
        if (unit == null ||
            factionRules == null ||
            unit.AgileManoeuvreUsedThisPhase ||
            TotalBattleFocusTokens(
                unit.FactionId
            ) <= 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        return UnitHasBattleFocusRules(
            unit
        );
    }

    private bool SpendBattleFocusFor(
        SquadController unit,
        string manoeuvre)
    {
        if (!CanUseBattleFocusManoeuvre(
                unit))
        {
            return false;
        }

        bool spent = false;

        AeldariGameController factionController =
            FactionControllerRuntime.GetAeldari(
                unit.FactionId);

        if (factionController != null &&
            factionController.BattleFocusTokens > 0)
        {
            spent =
                factionController.SpendBattleFocus(1, manoeuvre, unit);
        }

        if (!spent &&
            aeldariRules != null)
        {
            spent =
                aeldariRules
                    .SpendBonusBattleFocus(
                        unit.FactionId
                    );
        }

        if (!spent)
            return false;

        unit.AgileManoeuvreUsedThisPhase = true;

        status =
            manoeuvre +
            " — " +
            unit.DisplayName +
            ". Battle Focus: " +
            TotalBattleFocusTokens(
                unit.FactionId
            );

        return true;
    }

    public int AeldariMinimumSustainedHits(
        SquadController attacker,
        WeaponData weapon,
        AttackMode attackMode)
    {
        return aeldariRules != null
            ? aeldariRules.MinimumSustainedHits(
                attacker,
                weapon,
                attackMode
              )
            : 0;
    }

    public bool AeldariGrantsLethalHits(
        SquadController attacker,
        AttackMode attackMode)
    {
        return
            aeldariRules != null &&
            aeldariRules.GrantsLethalHits(
                attacker,
                attackMode
            );
    }

    public int AeldariApModifier(
        SquadController attacker,
        SquadController target,
        WeaponData weapon,
        AttackMode attackMode)
    {
        return aeldariRules != null
            ? aeldariRules.ApModifier(
                attacker,
                target,
                weapon,
                attackMode
              )
            : 0;
    }

    public int AeldariInvulnerableOverride(
        SquadController target)
    {
        return aeldariRules != null
            ? aeldariRules
                .InvulnerableOverride(
                    target
                )
            : 0;
    }

    public float AeldariRangedRangeModifier(
        SquadController attacker,
        WeaponData weapon)
    {
        return aeldariRules != null
            ? aeldariRules
                .RangedRangeModifier(
                    attacker,
                    weapon
                )
            : 0f;
    }

    private void OpenRuleChoice(
        string title,
        string description,
        IEnumerable<RuleChoiceOption> options)
    {
        ruleChoiceTitle =
            title ??
            "RULE CHOICE";

        ruleChoiceDescription =
            description ??
            "";

        ruleChoiceOptions.Clear();
        ruleChoiceScroll = Vector2.zero;

        if (options != null)
        {
            ruleChoiceOptions.AddRange(
                options.Where(
                    option =>
                        option != null
                )
            );
        }

        showRuleChoiceWindow =
            ruleChoiceOptions.Count > 0;
    }

    private void CloseRuleChoice()
    {
        showRuleChoiceWindow = false;
        ruleChoiceTitle = "";
        ruleChoiceDescription = "";
        ruleChoiceOptions.Clear();
    }

    public bool FriendlyEnhancementAuraWithin(
        SquadController unit,
        string ruleName,
        float distance,
        bool excludeCharacters)
    {
        if (unit == null)
            return false;

        return squads.Any(
            other =>
                other != null &&
                other.IsAlive &&
                other.IsOnBattlefield &&
                other.FactionId ==
                    unit.FactionId &&
                JoinedDistance(
                    other,
                    unit
                ) <=
                    distance + 0.001f &&
                (!excludeCharacters ||
                 !unit.HasKeyword(
                    "character")) &&
                FactionRuleSystem.UnitOrLeaderHasRule(
                    other,
                    ruleName
                )
        );
    }

    public bool SpendStratagemCPForUnit(
        SquadController unit,
        int cost,
        string label)
    {
        return SpendFactionStratagemCP(
            unit,
            cost,
            label
        );
    }

    private bool SpendFactionStratagemCP(
        SquadController target,
        int baseCost,
        string label)
    {
        if (target == null ||
            target.IsBattleShocked)
        {
            return false;
        }

        SquadController unit =
            target.JoinedActionController();

        if (unit.TargetedByFactionStratagemThisPhase)
        {
            status =
                label +
                ": that unit has already been targeted by a Stratagem this phase.";
            return false;
        }

        string usageKey =
            unit.FactionId +
            "|" +
            (label ?? "Stratagem");

        if (stratagemsUsedThisPhase.Contains(
                usageKey))
        {
            status =
                label +
                ": that Stratagem has already been used by this player this phase.";
            return false;
        }

        int cost =
            Mathf.Max(
                0,
                baseCost
            );

        cost =
            Aeldari11ModifyStratagemCost(
                unit, label, cost);

        SquadController overlord = null;

        if (FactionRuleSystem.UnitOrLeaderHasRule(
                unit,
                "My Will Be Done"))
        {
            if (UniversalRuleRegistry.UnitHasRule(
                    unit,
                    "My Will Be Done"))
            {
                overlord = unit;
            }
            else if (unit.AttachedLeader != null &&
                     UniversalRuleRegistry.UnitHasRule(
                        unit.AttachedLeader,
                        "My Will Be Done"))
            {
                overlord = unit.AttachedLeader;
            }

            if (overlord != null &&
                overlord.MyWillBeDoneUsedRound !=
                    round)
            {
                cost =
                    Mathf.Max(
                        0,
                        cost - 1
                    );
            }
        }

        if (!TrySpendCommandPoints(
                unit.FactionId,
                cost))
        {
            status =
                label +
                ": not enough CP.";
            return false;
        }

        stratagemsUsedThisPhase.Add(
            usageKey
        );

        unit.TargetedByFactionStratagemThisPhase = true;

        if (unit.AttachedLeader != null)
            unit.AttachedLeader.TargetedByFactionStratagemThisPhase = true;

        if (overlord != null &&
            cost < baseCost)
        {
            overlord.MyWillBeDoneUsedRound =
                round;

            status =
                "My Will Be Done reduced " +
                label +
                " by 1CP. ";
        }

        return true;
    }

    private bool OfferAeldariPathOfWarrior(
        SquadController unit,
        System.Action after)
    {
        if (unit == null ||
            aeldariRules == null ||
            !aeldariRules.IsPathOfWarriorUnit(
                unit))
        {
            return false;
        }

        SquadController actionUnit =
            unit.JoinedActionController();

        if (actionUnit
            .AeldariPathChoiceMadeThisPhase)
        {
            return false;
        }

        actionUnit
            .AeldariPathChoiceMadeThisPhase =
            true;

        if (FactionRuleSystem.UnitOrLeaderHasRule(
                actionUnit,
                "Mantle of Wisdom"))
        {
            actionUnit.AeldariRerollHitOnes =
                true;

            actionUnit.AeldariRerollWoundOnes =
                true;

            AppendBattleLog(
                "AELDARI",
                "Path of the Warrior",
                actionUnit.DisplayName +
                " gains both re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and re-roll Wound rolls of 1 from Mantle of Wisdom."
            );

            if (after != null)
                after();

            return true;
        }

        OpenRuleChoice(
            "PATH OF THE WARRIOR — " +
            actionUnit.DisplayName,
            IsXcomMode
            ? "Choose the Aspect Host attack discipline Warboard should apply until end of phase."
            : "Choose the attack discipline being used on the tabletop. Warboard records the state but does not interpret your Traditional dice.",
            new[]
            {
                new RuleChoiceOption(
                    "Re-roll Hit rolls of 1",
                    () =>
                    {
                        CloseRuleChoice();

                        actionUnit
                            .AeldariRerollHitOnes =
                            true;

                        AppendBattleLog(
                            "AELDARI",
                            "Path of the Warrior",
                            actionUnit.DisplayName +
                            " selected re-roll Hit rolls of 1."
                        );

                        if (after != null)
                            after();
                    }
                ),
                new RuleChoiceOption(
                    "Re-roll Wound rolls of 1",
                    () =>
                    {
                        CloseRuleChoice();

                        actionUnit
                            .AeldariRerollWoundOnes =
                            true;

                        AppendBattleLog(
                            "AELDARI",
                            "Path of the Warrior",
                            actionUnit.DisplayName +
                            " selected re-roll Wound rolls of 1."
                        );

                        if (after != null)
                            after();
                    }
                )
            }
        );

        return true;
    }

    private void CloseStratagemReaction()
    {
        showStratagemReaction = false;
        pendingReactionContext = null;

        pendingChargeAttacker = null;
        pendingChargeTarget = null;

        pendingChargeRoll = 0;
        pendingOriginalChargeRoll = 0;
    }

    private string OtherFaction(
        string faction)
    {
        return factions.FirstOrDefault(
            value =>
                value != faction
        ) ?? faction;
    }

    private string CommandPointText()
    {
        return string.Join(
            "    ",
            factions.Select(
                faction =>
                    DisplayFactionName(
                        faction
                    ) +
                    ": " +
                    GetCommandPoints(
                        faction
                    ) +
                    " CP"
            ).ToArray()
        );
    }

    private string DisplayFactionName(
        string faction)
    {
        if (faction == "Player 1")
            return playerOneRosterLabel;

        if (faction == "Player 2")
            return playerTwoRosterLabel;

        return faction;
    }

    public string WorldUiFactionId(
        int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 ||
            index >= factions.Count)
        {
            return "";
        }

        return factions[index];
    }

    public string WorldUiFactionName(
        int index)
    {
        string faction =
            WorldUiFactionId(
                index
            );

        return
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                faction)
            ? "PLAYER " +
              (index + 1)
            : DisplayFactionName(
                faction
              );
    }

    public int WorldUiCommandPoints(
        int index)
    {
        return GetCommandPoints(
            WorldUiFactionId(
                index
            )
        );
    }

    private void TryUiStratagem(
        System.Func<bool> action,
        string displayName)
    {
        bool used =
            action != null &&
            action();

        if (!used)
        {
            status =
                displayName +
                " is not available for the selected unit in the current phase / trigger.";
        }
    }

    private string ActiveFactionDisplayName()
    {
        return DisplayFactionName(
            activeFaction
        );
    }

    public static Color FactionColor(string factionId)
    {
        if (factionId == "Aeldari" ||
            factionId == "Player 1")
        {
            return new Color(
                0.65f,
                0.22f,
                0.72f
            );
        }

        if (factionId == "Necrons" ||
            factionId == "Player 2")
        {
            return new Color(
                0.18f,
                0.72f,
                0.40f
            );
        }

        return Color.gray;
    }

}
